comparison.objective: Roll puff pastry into an even 3 mm sheet while keeping a spacer-ring rolling pin level; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous bimanual rolling-pressure and level control over deformable material versus small-tool engagement, collar turning, locking and physical test cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Specified pastry thickness and uniformity without rolling off the ends versus safe, repeatable carriage deceleration. Candidate lacks numeric rebound/overload/drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Deformable thickness control is meaningfully unrelated to mechanical damping adjustment.
